1. (Currently amended) An ultrasonic surgical instrument assembly comprising: a handpiece; a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece; a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator; and a light source attached to said handpiece so as to direct at least visible electromagnetic radiation along the probe towards a surgical site distal of the probe, __wherein said light source is positioned at a location other than a distal end of said handpiece__.

2. (Original)

3. (Original)

4. (Original)

5. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1, further comprising __a removable fastener for attaching said light source to said handpiece__.

6. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 5, further comprising __at least one additional removable fastener for attaching said power supply at least indirectly to said handpiece__.

7. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1, __wherein said power supply is a battery mounted at least indirectly to said handpiece and operatively connected to said light source__.

8. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1 __wherein said light source includes a light-emitting diode operatively connected to a power supply__.

9. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1 __wherein said light source is attached to a proximal or rear end of said handpiece, further comprising an optical fiber extending from said light source to a distal end portion of said handpiece and a power supply operatively connected to said light source__.

10. (Cancelled)

11. (Currently amended) An accessory for a surgical instrument comprising a handpiece, a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece, and a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator, said accessory comprising: a light source; __a removable fastener for attaching said light source to said handpiece__; and at least one power supply component operatively connectable to said light source.

12. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said power supply component includes __a coil configured to be disposed about a power cable feeding said transducer or generator, with a removable fastener for attaching said coil about the power cable__.

13. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 12 wherein said power supply component further includes a slow-drain capacitor operatively connected to said coil and connectable to said light source for providing illumination energy to said light source for a predetermined period of time after a termination of power conduction through said cable.

14. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein __the power supply component includes a battery operatively connectable to said light source__.

15. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said light source includes __a light-emitting diode operatively connected to a power supply component__.

16. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said fastener is configured for attaching said light source to a proximal or rear end of said handpiece, further comprising an optical fiber __operatively connected to said light source__ and at least one additional fastener for removably attaching said optical fiber to said handpiece so that said optical fiber extends from said light source to a distal end portion of said handpiece.

17. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said fastener is configured for attaching said light source to a distal end of said handpiece __and said light source is operatively connected to a power supply component__ and for orienting said light source to provide illumination along said probe to a surgical site.

18. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said fastener is __selected from the group consisting of a clip, a clamp, and a band__.

19. (Currently amended) A surgical method comprising: providing a surgical instrument having a handpiece, a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece and a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator; providing a light source; applying a fastener to said handpiece to attach said light source thereto so that light from said light source is directed __along a path substantially parallel to said probe__; operating said surgical instrument to apply ultrasonic vibratory energy to a surgical site; during the operating of said surgical instrument, conducting electrical energy from a power supply to said light source; and during the operating of said surgical instrument and the conducting of said electrical energy, illuminating said surgical site with light from said source.

20. (Currently amended) The surgical method defined in claim 19 further comprising __removably mounting said power supply at least indirectly to said handpiece using a removable fastener__.

21. (Currently amended) The surgical method defined in claim 20 wherein said power supply includes a coil, the removable mounting of said power supply at least indirectly to said handpiece including __disposing said coil about a power cable feeding said transducer or generator and securing said coil with a removable fastener__.

22. (Currently amended) The surgical method defined in claim 21 wherein said power supply further includes a slow-drain capacitor operatively connected to said coil, further comprising operating said capacitor to provide illumination energy to said light source for a predetermined period of time after a termination of power conduction through said cable.

23. (Currently amended) The surgical method defined in claim 19, further comprising __removing said fastener and said light source from said handpiece after completion of an operation on said surgical site__.

24. (Currently amended) The surgical method defined in claim 19 wherein the applying of said fastener includes positioning said light source at a proximal or rear end of said handpiece, further comprising attaching an optical fiber to said handpiece so that said fiber extends from said light source at said proximal end of said handpiece to a distal end of said handpiece __and operatively connecting said light source to a power supply__.

25. (Currently amended) An accessory for a medical instrument comprising a handpiece and a probe or tool extension on a distal end of said handpiece, said accessory comprising: a light source; __a removable fastener for attaching said light source to said instrument__; and at least one power supply component operatively connectable to said light source, __wherein said power supply component includes a coil configured to be disposed about a power cable extending to said handpiece, with a removable fastener for securing said coil about the power cable__.

26. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 25 wherein said power supply component further includes a slow-drain capacitor operatively connected to said coil and connectable to said light source for providing illumination energy to said light source for a predetermined period of time after a termination of power conduction through said cable.
